name: The Acid Queens of the Moon
source:
In the distant future of 2320,
In a city-state underneath the lunar surface...

Lulu's had a bad day at work and wants to get piss-drunk to kick off her weekend. But her resourceful friend Alison has another suggestion, one that will prove life changing... join Lulu on her very first acid trip as she has a chill and fun day!

[From [url=https://air-gong.itch.io/the-acid-queens-of-the-moon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在遥远的未来2320年，
在月球表面下的一个城邦中……

露露今天工作很糟糕，她想喝个醉来开始她的周末。但她足智多谋的朋友艾莉森提出了另一个建议，这个建议将改变生活……和露露一起开始她的第一次酸之旅，因为她度过了寒冷而有趣的一天！

[来自[url=https://air-gong.itch.io/the-acid-queens-of-the-moon]Itch.io[/url]]
